name: Arsonist raises the critical damage of Ember spenders (#1809)
contract: #1809: Arsonist 301286 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER 108 on SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (misc 15) with bp 9 (+10 percent) and class mask A 0x200040, B 0x8000, C 0x800000, which covers Explode 800792, Flames of Neltharion 801915 and Ignis Ultimatus 680369. Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus scales only the bonus portion: for these magic spells (DmgClass 1) a base of 1000 crits for 1500, and with the modifier for 1500 + 50 = 1550. spell_critical_damage reads exactly that function from a fixed base of 1000, so each spender must gain 50 over its own pre-passive value (asserted as 49..51 to absorb float rounding). No script exists for 301286.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Arsonist adds 10 percent of the crit bonus to Explode (1500 -> 1550 on a base of 1000)
Arsonist adds 10 percent of the crit bonus to Flames of Neltharion (1500 -> 1550 on a base of 1000)
Arsonist adds 10 percent of the crit bonus to Ignis Ultimatus (1500 -> 1550 on a base of 1000)
